# Showcase Dark Elf Dragon Flight — darkelf — 576 points

*v1999.12.0*

## Roboprosthetic Dark Elf (6×)

- Size: Medium
- Models: 4x Roboprosthetic Dark Elf
- Type: Bio, Infantry, Walking, Roboprosthetic
- Armor: 3/3/3/3
- Points: 32
- Shaken: slow [-, -, Flee] / Can't use weapons

- **To Hit**: Take Cover[Still][-2]; Take Cover[Crawl][-2]

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 0-5 | Kill 1 model |
| 6-8 | Kill 1 model, d6 Psychic damage |
| 9 | Destroy unit |
- When one model is killed, half all +1 to future damage rounded down
- If killed by poison, remove that instance

**Damage Table: Psychic**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 5+ | Unit shaken |


### Roboprosthetic Dark Elf

- Equipment: 1x SMG
- Assault: strength 1/1/1/1 (5+), deflection 1/1/0/0 (6+), damage d6-2, AP 2


- **Cunning Assault**: [2]
- **Penalty**: Reroll all success in assault while crawling

#### SMG

- Range: 3, angle True/True/True/True, damage d6-3, AP 1
- **Ammo**: Always treated as loaded
- **Multiple Shots**: Fires two times each time it is fired


---

## Mechanical Red Dragon

- Size: Huge
- Models: 1x Mechanical Red Dragon
- Type: Mechanical, Walking, Flying
- Armor: 11/8/8/7
- Points: 384
- Shaken: slow [-, -, -] / Can't use weapons

- **Resistance**: Fire[2]
- **Immunity**: [Acid]. Also immune to Gear Disruption

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1-4 | +1 on future damage |
| 5-10 | +1 on future damage, shaken |
| 13+ | Unit destroyed |


### Mechanical Red Dragon

- Equipment: 1x Fire Breath
- Assault: strength 12/8/8/4 (5+), deflection 12/8/8/4 (6+), damage d6, AP 7


- **Lands**: Assault ground: automatically assaults ground troops if it shares a hex with an enemy ground unit. if so, consider the dragon to be in slow state and the rest of movement orders to be nothing

#### Fire Breath

- Range: 3, angle True/False/False/False, damage -, AP 0
- **Area**: [4+]. at point blank; [5+]. at normal range; [6+]. at long range
- **Range Extra Damage**: Poison[6]. No regular damage.; Fire
- **Bonus**: Any unit within long range and in front arc gets a minor acid token
